Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle 2, The.name: The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle 2
Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle 2, The.summary: Bugs Bunny must save his girlfriend Honey Bunny from Witch Hazel's enemy-filled castle. There are 28 levels with keys to collect. In each level is a locked door leading to the next level; to open it, the player must collect eight keys placed throughout the level. Various Looney Tunes characters are encountered, including Yosemite Sam, Daffy Duck, Wile E. Coyote, Sylvester, Foghorn Leghorn, Tasmanian Devil, Beaky Buzzard, Spike, Merlin the Magic Mouse, and Tweety.

Bust-A-Move 2 - Arcade Edition.name: Bust-A-Move 2: Arcade Edition
Bust-A-Move 2 - Arcade Edition.summary:
Bub and Bob are back! Like in Tetris in reverse, you shoot bubbles at an array of different-colored bubbles stuck in an ever descending ceiling, attempting to match them up three by three to make them disappear.

This edition contains both puzzle challenges, multiplayer and normal progressive stages.

Dino Breeder 2.name: Dino Breeder 2
Dino Breeder 2.summary: Dino Breeder 2 is a Simulation game, published by J-Wing, which was released in Japan in 1998.

Malibu Beach Volleyball.name: Malibu Beach Volleyball
Malibu Beach Volleyball.summary: Welcome to Malibu: Volleyball capital of the world. This is where the best come to play--and show off their tans. If you want in, sign up. But keep your eyes on the ball...there'll be plenty of time for bikini-watching after the match!

Pyramids of Ra.name: Pyramids of Ra
Pyramids of Ra.summary: Pyramids of Ra is an Action game, developed by Micros and published by Matchbox, which was released in 1993.

Star Wars - The Empire Strikes Back.name: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back

Sword of Hope II, The.name: The Sword of Hope II
Sword of Hope II, The.summary: The Sword of Hope II is a role-playing game. Take on the role of young Prince Theo of Riccar and embark on a mission to find the truth behind a mystery that is threatening the kingdom. The key to solving the numerous puzzles and gimmicks is the use of commands like "look," "open" and "hit." You'll encounter many places and items during the adventure, plus some friends waiting to lend a hand along the way.

Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II - Back f.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: Back from the Sewers
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II - Back f.summary: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles II: Back from the Sewers, released as Teenage Mutant Hero Turtles II: Back from the Sewers in Europe, and simply Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2 in Japan, is a 1991 Game Boy game by Konami. It is the sequel to Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Fall of the Foot Clan.
